scope: Exact view anatomy/orientation/topology/labels. Additional labelled sources used for TG orientation; root separately reviewed final grid thumbnails.

results.observation: TG two-chamber: LV left, LA right, MV between; no invented right heart or outflow.
TG RV inflow: RV left, RA right, TV between; thin atrium and RV wall; corroborated with BSE labelled examples.
TG long-axis: LV left, LA upper-right, LVOT/Ao lower-right, small RV far-field beneath LV; corroborated with labelled Canadian Figure6C.
Descending aorta SAX is a circular lumen with thin vessel wall, no cusps or false septum.
Descending aorta LAX is a longitudinal tube, no valves or invented branches.
UE arch LAX preserves oblique longitudinal tube at0–10 degrees; no inappropriate TTE suprasternal three-branch anatomy.
UE arch SAX at70–90 degrees has separate near-field round arch and far-field longitudinal PA/pulmonary valve; no false connection or arterial-branch mislabel.

limitations: Selective educational navigation schematics, not independent clinical validation or complete structure inventories.
